question: At present, how many fundamental duties are mentioned in the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is 11.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There are **Eleven Fundamental Duties,** which are as follows:

 
 
• Respect the Constitution, the National Anthem, and the flag of your country.
 
• Embrace the principles of the struggle for** liberation.**
 
• Preserve **India's integrity and sovereignty**.
 
• When required, defend the nation and **perform civic duties**.
 
• A feeling of camaraderie among everybody.
 
• Maintain a** diverse culture.**
 
• Keep the surroundings natural.
 
• Embrace a scientific mindset.
 
• Keep public property safe.
 
• Aim for **superiority.**
 
• All **parents and guardians** have a responsibility to **enroll their children in school** between the ages of **6 to 14**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Fundamental Duties of India** are connected to **the Swaran Singh Committee.**
 
• The Swaran Singh Committee's recommendations led to the addition of 11 Fundamental Duties to the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Fundamental Duties are covered by** Article 51A of the Indian Constitution.**
 
• The **42nd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1976** added the Fundamental Duties to the Indian Constitution.
 
• The **USSR** provided the idea for the Indian constitution's essential obligations **(Union of Soviet Socialist Republics).**
